Paragraph: "Distressed at heart that foremost monkey gazed blankly in all directions and he did not remain at any one place..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Extreme restlessness and distress causing physical disquiet and spatial instability.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva paces continuously and scans his environment erratically.
Outcome/Resolution: He manifests physical signs of acute panic and inability to settle.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Udvega (Acute emotional agitation and psychological disquiet)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Demonstrates how inner fear obscures spiritual stillness, leaving the individual agitated and wandering aimlessly.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Motor agitation and cognitive distress: inability to sit still or focus due to acute flight-or-fight sympathetic arousal.
